app.name: next-lms
app.tagline: Run your classes, students, and learning in one place.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Welcome back. Sign in to continue.
signIn.linkError: That link has expired or was already used. If you already confirmed your email, just sign in. To reset your password, request a new link.
signIn.confirmedNotice: Your email is confirmed. Sign in to continue.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.description: Set up next-lms for your teaching in a couple of minutes.
signUp.terms: By creating an account you agree to keep student information confidential and use it only for teaching.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.description: We've sent you a confirmation link. Open it on any device to finish creating your account.
checkEmail.spam: Can't find it? Check your spam folder, or try signing up again in a few minutes.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: You'll stay signed in after changing it.

onboarding.title: Create your workspace
onboarding.description: A workspace holds your classes, students and team. You can change these settings later.

fields.name: Workspace name
fields.nameHint: For example your own name, or your institute's name.
fields.timezoneHint: Class times and dates are shown in this time zone.

today.emptyBody: Once you add classes and timetables, today's sessions appear here so you can take attendance in a few taps.

settings.title: Workspace settings
settings.description: Regional settings used for dates, times and fees across this workspace.
settings.readOnly: Only the workspace owner can change these settings.

account.title: Your account
account.description: Your name and contact details are visible to the workspaces you belong to.
account.changePassword: To change your password, use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

errors.invalidPhone: Use international format starting with +, e.g. +94771234567.
errors.passwordTooWeak: That password is too easy to guess. Try a longer one.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password different from your current one.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email first — check your inbox for the link.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.signUpFailed: We couldn't create your account. Please try again.
errors.orgLimit: You've reached the maximum number of workspaces.
errors.notAllowed: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

messages.resetEmailSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
